landing.headline: Stop shipping orders that kill your bottom line.
landing.subheadline: Arthiva scores every order before dispatch, calculates expected margin across journeys, rescues in-transit delivery exceptions (NDRs), and turns RTO losses into recovered profits.
landing.alreadyAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
landing.demoBanner: Interactive demonstration mode active with 80+ realistic test orders, couriers, and waterfalls.
landing.pillarsTitle: Engineered specifically for Indian D2C delivery economics
landing.pillarsSubtitle: Most platforms only look at RTO risk percentage. Arthiva computes pure expected margin in rupees to recommend the highest-yield action.
landing.pillar1Desc: Evaluate Full COD, OTP confirmation, and Prepaid incentive journeys side-by-side using real courier and pincode history.
landing.pillar2Desc: Address fake delivery attempts, customer unavailable flags, and incorrect addresses with automated WhatsApp interventions.
landing.pillar3Desc: Rank recovery actions for RTO-initiated orders: decide instantly whether to reattempt, reroute to local fulfillment, or restock.
landing.footerDisclaimer: Arthiva is a small-scale pilot project built for Indian D2C ecommerce brands. Local state persists seamlessly across sessions.

pricing.title: Simple, margin-positive pilot plans
